title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover the best environments for focused work and collaboration across the D'Youville University campus, from high-tech hubs to historic lounges.

cards.title: Library 4th Floor Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Quiet Study at Montante Family Library
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor for the most dedicated quiet study environment on campus. Use your ID card to access this floor 24/7 for late-night or early-morning sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 quiet study floor located within the Montante Family Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 4th floor study spaces of the Montante Family Library are open 24/7 with swipe-card access.
cards.source_title: Annual Security and Fire Safety Report 2021
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with a valid D'Youville ID card.

cards.title: The Hive Collaborative Workspace
cards.subtitle: Innovation Space in the Health Professions Hub
cards.notes: Visit the second and third floors of the Hub to find this modern, collaborative workspace. It features flexible furniture and is ideal for group projects and networking.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative co-working and study space located in the Health Professions Hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hive is a collaborative workspace lining the second and third floors of the Health Professions Hub.
cards.source_title: D'Youville Hosts Grand Opening for Health Professions Hub
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

cards.title: The Park Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Lounge in Koessler Administration Building
cards.notes: Located on the second floor of KAB, this lounge offers booths and tables for studying. It is open 24/7, making it a reliable spot for students at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 student lounge and advocacy center on the second floor of KAB.
cards.evidence_claim: The Park Advocacy Center is open 24/7 and provides students with a safe space to hang out and study on the second floor of KAB.

cards.title: The Beach Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Second Floor Lounge in KAB
cards.notes: Find this student experience home base on the second floor of the Koessler Administration Building. It serves as a casual lounge area for quick study sessions between classes.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge and home base for Student Experience on the second floor of KAB.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach is a student lounge and the home base of Student Experience on the second floor of KAB.

cards.title: Joan of Arc Hall Study Space
cards.subtitle: Connector Space Between BFAC and KAB
cards.notes: Use this quiet connector hall as a study area. It links the Bauer Family Academic Center and Koessler Administration Building and doubles as a lobby for the Kavinoky Theatre.
cards.short_summary: A study space located in the hall connecting BFAC and KAB.
cards.evidence_claim: Joan of Arc Hall, which connects BFAC and KAB, serves as both a study space and the Kavinoky's lobby.
cards.source_title: Annual Security and Fire Safety Report 2021

cards.title: IT Pulse Center & Tech Lounge
cards.subtitle: First Floor of Bauer Family Academic Center
cards.notes: Located on the first floor of BFAC, this lounge provides workstations and study spaces. It is the go-to spot for students needing technical assistance while they work.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused study lounge on the first floor of the BFAC building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tech Lounge, located on the first floor of the Bauer Family Academic Center, includes study spaces and workstations.

cards.title: Madonna Lounge
cards.subtitle: First Floor Active Learning Center
cards.notes: Visit the first floor of Madonna Hall to find the Madonna Lounge and Active Learning Center. This space is designed for modern, interactive study sessions.
cards.short_summary: An active learning center and lounge located on the first floor of Madonna Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: A futuristic Active Learning Center and Madonna Lounge are located on the 1st floor of Madonna Hall.
cards.source_title: Annual Security and Fire Safety Report 2021
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during building hours.

cards.title: DAC 6th Floor Study Area
cards.subtitle: Top Floor Views at the DAC
cards.notes: Head to the top floor of the D'Youville Academic Center for a quiet study environment. The DAC is known for its numerous classrooms and dedicated study spaces throughout.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area located on the 6th floor of the D'Youville Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6th Floor is the top floor of DAC, which is noted for containing technology centers and study spaces.

cards.title: Maggie's Café Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Lower Level of the ALT Building
cards.notes: Grab a smoothie and find a table in the lower level of the Dr. Pauline M. Alt Building. This spot offers plenty of seating and is perfect for casual studying between classes.
cards.short_summary: A dining and study area located in the basement of the ALT building.
cards.evidence_claim: Maggie's Cafe is situated in the basement of the ALT building and features space for studying and socializing.
cards.access_notes: Open during dining hours; typically weekdays 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

cards.title: Container Park Outdoor Study
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Space Outside the DAC
cards.notes: When the weather is nice, head to the Container Park outside the DAC. It's a great spot for catching up on studies in an open-air environment when no events are scheduled.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor social and study space located adjacent to the D'Youville Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Container Park, located outside the DAC, is a great space for socialization or catching up on studies when there are no concerts.
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; best used during daylight hours.
